caption: Image editor — crop an image or make targeted edits.
Audio editor — inspect the waveform and remove unwanted ranges.
Video editor — trim clips and cut unwanted footage.
Video editor — reframe a clip for a different aspect ratio.
Video composer — arrange clips and configure the final composition.
Subtitle editor — revise cues, adjust timing, and review warnings.
Screenplay editor — revise a Fountain script alongside its formatted preview.
Markdown editor — edit source text alongside the rendered document.
